scope: Independent review of Root-authored plan only. This is not code review, source execution approval, operational literal approval or runtime qualification.
authorship_disclosure: Reviewer authored inherited older Restore and SafetySQL helpers. Reviewer did not author this Root plan or any proposed bound-evidence-v4 replacement.

source_review.proof: The no-BEGIN branch unconditionally appends COMMIT. Exact parsed source-customer has no BEGIN and one terminal COMMIT; emitted old tail therefore has two COMMIT statements. The schedule source has the same supported defect. app-read has no transaction statement and needs one final COMMIT.

required_implementation_precision: Restrict normalization to admitted positive SQL bytes and reviewed outer transaction statements. Statement-aware parsing or equally strict source-shaped boundary validation must distinguish transaction statements from comments, quoted strings and dollar-quoted function bodies; no broad substring removal.

Accept only the closed reviewed envelope modes: no wrapper; one terminal bare COMMIT; or one outer BEGIN plus one terminal bare COMMIT. Remove only the redundant outer BEGIN for an already-open captured transaction. Reject intermediate/multiple transaction commands, ROLLBACK, prepared/chained/transaction-option variants and ambiguous shapes rather than normalizing them into success.

Preserve all business statement bytes/order and existing negative binder path, issuer separate COMMIT, captured tuple and same-xid witnesses. Keep exact closed response, empty stderr, ACK, marker/state and global closure requirements.

Retain bounded normalization enums/counts and fixed stderr-empty/completion booleans before assertion, never raw diagnostics. Unexpected warnings remain STOP; normalization is not warning suppression.

Process-boundary mocks must model actual transaction state and independently emit a warning for a second COMMIT. Use actual pinned Customer/schedule/read sources through real bound_operation; old-construction restoration must fail. Cover all allowed envelopes and rejected shapes plus current closure/IO/sanitization regressions.

Use actual complete source preparer/loader/pinner/PENDING and whole owning main tests with only process/resource boundaries mocked; retain real comparator provenance and full source graph. No production factory replacement or handmade native PASS data.
plain_english: The script adds an extra finish command to work that already has one. The plan fixes that extra command and keeps every check. We still do not know the exact old warning.
